build_SO2_Convolution: build a python module to perform SO(2) convolutions for all m orders with optional radial weights
build_SO2_Linear: build a python module to perform SO(2) linear transformations for all m orders with radial function support
build_SO2_m_Conv_Block: build a python module to perform SO(2) convolution with block-diagonal GEMM for faster tensor core utilization
refactor_SO2_Convolution_to_block: refactor an SO2_Convolution to use SO2_Conv1_WithRadialBlock or SO2_Conv2_InternalBlock via convert_so2_conv1 or convert_so2_conv2
review_SO2_m_Conv: review the SO2_m_Conv class that performs SO(2) convolution on features corresponding to plus or minus m
